Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform
for on-the-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting
environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the
transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We
offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of
tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700
employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give
their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True
to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse,
dedicated and unique team! What you can expect Do you want to play an
active role in driving a company’s growth and turning big plans into
reality? Then join our team! You can look forward to exciting
challenges, an inspiring environment, and a work culture that combines
flexibility and collaboration – with our 60/40 hybrid model and
modern offices in Ratingen as a hub for ideas. As part of our team,
you will take on the following responsibilities: You analyze the
existing system, infrastructure, and CMDB landscape and develop
technical architecture and design concepts to support its continuous
evolution. You design, plan, and implement infrastructure and asset
management solutions while ensuring their seamless integration into
the existing IT architecture. You are responsible for the ongoing
development of CMDB structures and for ensuring high data quality and
consistency across all infrastructure domains. You establish and
enhance standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks for the
identification, maintenance, and classification of IT assets. You own
and further develop the company-wide Asset Classification methodology
(CIAA) and ensure its consistent application in line with security,
risk, and compliance requirements. You ensure comprehensive and
reliable asset inventory management and provide transparency regarding
relationships and dependencies between systems, services, and
infrastructure components. You assess IT assets based on their
protection requirements and derive corresponding architecture,
security, and design standards. You advise internal IT teams on CMDB,

architectural decisions with business objectives. As the central point
of contact for CMDB architecture, you work closely with IT Operations,
IT Security, Enterprise Architecture, and Service Management teams.

Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification in the IT field.

continuously improving complex IT infrastructures, including their
documentation and modeling. You possess hands-on experience with ITSM
platforms, CMDB solutions, and their integration into enterprise IT
environments. You have practical experience in IT Asset Management and
Configuration Management, including assessing assets in terms of
criticality, risk, and protection requirements. You have a strong
understanding of the interdependencies between IT architecture, CMDB,
asset inventory management, CIAA classification, security
requirements, and compliance frameworks. You are familiar with
industry standards and frameworks such as ITIL, ISMS, as well as
regulatory requirements including NIS2 and DORA. Ideally, you have
experience managing external service providers and collaborating
across various IT functions. You work in a structured, analytical, and
solution-oriented manner and possess strong consulting and
communication skills. Fluent German and very good English skills
complete your profile. We are looking forward to your application and
to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age,
gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled
applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This
position can be full-time or part-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join the dynamic Internal Consulting team at Boehringer Ingelheim! We're looking for innovative thinkers who are ready to shape our company's future.
As a Manager Consulting, you'll design, execute, and steer strategic initiatives within Boehringer Ingelheim. You'll independently coordinate project tasks, run data analyses, develop hypotheses and strategize solutions.
We value work-life balance, offering flexible work models and a location at the Headquarters in the Frankfurt Rhine-Main area.
This position is part time eligible with min. 80%.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As Manager Consulting, you will support in the design, execution and steering of strategic initiatives across businesses, functions, therapeutic areas, and regions within Boehringer Ingelheim.
- You will independently drive work packages within projects, generating strategic insights to enable informed decisions of top-level leaders.
- With your experience, you will run data analyses, develop hypotheses, find possible strategic paths and create actionable solutions to advance the organization.
- Having the successful outcome always in mind, you will track the progress and strategic alignment of projects and initiatives, in close collaboration with our business partners.

Requirements

- Excellent master's degree in sciences, economics or engineering (PhD or MBA a plus)
- Several years' experience with top-tier management consultancy, preferably with a focus on Pharma
- Track record of working on diverse national and international strategic projects
- Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, with high attention to detail
- Great team player, with strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills
- C1 level English (written and verbal); additional languages are a plus

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until August 21st, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to August 07th, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting
Step 3: On-site interviews
Please submit your application documents in English.

jobs.description:
As part of the Precision Optics business unit of the MATERION Corporation, we are among the world's leading manufacturers of optical components. Our production sites in Europe, North America, and Asia offer a unique range of optical
coatings, glass processing, structuring and bonding technologies, as well as the
manufacturing of complete assemblies.

We are seeking a highly experienced and meticulous 

**Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter (m/f/d)** 

About the Role:

For our site in Jena we are seeking a motivated senior accountant with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience who is eager to develop their skills and contribute to the financial health of our manufacturing business. This role offers hands-on accounting tasks, ensuring compliance with German accounting standards, and supporting month-end close and reporting activities in an US based corporation.

This role requires a proactive and responsible accountant who can independently manage day-to-day accounting operations and serve as the primary finance contact at the Jena site. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with corporate finance, tax, and audit teams to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

- Take ownership of the accounting function onsite, ensuring timely and accurate financial data and reporting.
- Assist with the month-end and year-end close processes, including preparing journal entries and performing account reconciliations.
- Support accounts payable (A/P) and accounts receivable (A/R) activities, including invoice processing and payment follow-ups.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date general ledger records.
- Assist in inventory accounting and support basic cost tracking activities 
- Ensure compliance with local statutory accounting requirements and internal policies.
- Support preparation of financial reports and assist with variance analysis to help management understand financial performance.
- Act as the main local point of contact for internal and external stakeholders related to accounting and finance matters.
- Coordinate with corporate finance and tax teams to support consolidated reporting and compliance requirements.
- Support audit processes by preparing documentation and responding to queries independently.
- Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and contribute to system enhancements.
- Identify and escalate issues or risks to corporate finance as needed.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent professional qualification, e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter/in).
- 3 to 5 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of accounting processes.
- Strong communication and coordination skills to liaise effectively within a global matrix organization.
- Experience in managing relationships with external service providers (e.g., auditors, tax consultants) is a plus.
- Basic understanding of cost accounting principles.
- Familiarity with local German accounting standards and tax regulations.
- Knowledge of international accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP) is beneficial but not required.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel (including basic formulas and data handling).
- Good command of English and German (spoken and written).
- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Eagerness to learn, take initiative, and work collaboratively in a team environment.

What We Offer:

- A varied and hands-on role in a dynamic, international company.
- Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
- Supportive and positive working atmosphere with motivated colleagues.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21
